Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly assumed the provided note in parentheses ("Note: Alfred Gell was Australian, and Edmund Leach was a New Zealander") was factual knowledge rather than a hallucination or incorrect premise injected into the prompt. In reality, Alfred Gell was British (born in England) and Edmund Leach was British (born in England). Both were prominent British social anthropologists. The agent failed to verify this information via the available tools (WebSurfer) and blindly accepted the incorrect statement, leading to a wrong final answer.
